newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian minister to visit Japan, Korea.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian minister to visit Japan, Korea.

text.p: Australian Resources Minister Warwick Parer will visit Japan and South Korea between September 28 and October 4, his office said on Friday.
Parer will meet political leaders and senior representatives of the power, steel and mineral sectors in both countries.

He will use the visits to explain the Australian government's policy objectives and to follow up issues which were considered at last month's APEC Energy Ministers' meeting in Sydney, his office said in a statement.
